item.title: M90 / A9000 (General)
item.description:
🟢 Minor traffic restriction
• There is currently no access to the M90 heading south at Junction 1b, due to overnight works on the on slip. Permitted vehicles can still access the A9000 FRB from this section.
Updated: 20:02

item.description:

Updated: 20:14
